leon-jimenes--series-300-cameroon.description: Introduced by La Aurora in 2007 for the company's anniversary, Series 300 takes its name from an extra 300 days of ageing. A Cameroon-seed wrapper grown in Ecuador covers a Nicaraguan binder and Dominican, Peruvian and Nicaraguan filler, rolled in Santiago. The smoke is dark and earthy, with caramel, spice and cocoa.

thirds.notes: Dark coffee and deep earth give way to burnt caramel and nutmeg, with pepper building towards a cayenne-like finish.
The caramel-and-spice course holds steady, with a thick, medium-full smoke and an even burn.
Dark cocoa, black coffee and earth take over on both draw and finish as the strength edges up.

sources.title: Cigar Obsession – León Jimenes Series 300 Robusto review

leon-jimenes--double-maduro.description: Double Maduro is La Aurora's darker, stronger León Jimenes: instead of Connecticut shade it wears a CuBra wrapper, Cuban-seed tobacco grown in Brazil, fermented twice, over Dominican and Nicaraguan tobacco. The smoke is slightly sweet, with chocolate from the wrapper and a peppery, citrus lift.

sources.title: Cigar Country – León Jimenes Doble Maduro
